title: Chicago, the train
logline: The Chicago room's window, close: the train she could hear, drawn as a shape crossing the glass, the orange of the room on the sill, a radiator ticking beneath. From the postcard's one sentence, the second page it gets.

panels.composition: Close on a hotel window at night: an elevated train drawn as a long jagged sound shape crossing the glass, an orange wall's color on the sill, a radiator's fins beneath drawn with small tick marks.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a hotel window at night with an elevated train drawn as a long jagged sound shape crossing the glass, orange wall color on the sill and a radiator with small tick marks beneath, no words
image.notes: The postcard: 'the room is orange and I can hear the train' (ro_2021-12-05).

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
